steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan... doesn't Lateran food bug you at least, like, a little...?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Tastes here definitely lean on the sugary side, compared to Kjerag.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Don't you like sweet, though, Rus?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That doesn't mean I can take everything sweet!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: *Sigh* I'm starting to miss Kjerag now.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It's that bitch Ratatos's fault, all blah blah 'grab every opportunity to reestablish our clan's status'... and she didn’t even come herself, throwing me under the sleigh out here.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: It's a show of the Matriarch's trust in you. After that incident put us on the brink, it was your joint efforts with her that ensured the Browntails held on.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And you got tossed off to the side. You just love living behind the scenes, don't you?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Personally speaking, getting to see you shine is more than enough satisfaction for me, Rus.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ooh, when did you learn to talk so smooth?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: That aside, Madame, this conference may turn out more fruitful than we expected.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: We didn't think so many countries would be here. It seems we might've underestimated Laterano's influence.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yeah, that does sound about right... but don't you change the subject!

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: (Leithanian) Ugh, do you not have eyes?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Leithanian) You bumped into me, I think.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: Your Leithanian is an embarrassment. What corner of the hinterland did you scurry out of?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I come from Kjerag, and it's certainly not the 'hinterland.'

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: Kjerag?

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: What kind of place is Kjerag?

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: Lady Sharon, Kjerag is the nation of the Snow Realm in the buffer zone between Victoria, Columbia, and Kazimierz.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: There's a country in those mountains? Hah, the very definition of hinterland!

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: You think an envoy of a trifling glacial state has the standing to be flippant with me, a duchess?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Madame, first, I have to stress again, Kjerag isn't some 'hinterland' like you keep saying. You can probably thank your own narrow mind that you've never heard of my country.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Second, you're the one who bumped into me. You owe me an apology.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: You dare!

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: Lady Sharon, we're in the Basilica...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Lady Sharon, permit I remind you, you currently stand in Laterano, and not your Leithanian domain.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: And who are you?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: A Lateran Legatus.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: What are you trying to tell me, Legatus? This is the Basilica? What, do you intend to declare that as the host, Laterano sides with this provincial creature?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Laterano sides with order. Therefore, Lady Sharon, you should apologize to Madame Sciurus.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You know my name?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You'd expect me to know the names of all the diplomatic envoys, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: Oh? Then you must be well aware of who I am.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Of course, Duchess Francis of Leithanien.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But permit I remind you again, this is Laterano, Duchess.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: In Laterano, you are asked to honor the Commandments and orderly abide the rule of law. No matter what privileges you enjoy in Leithanien, they do not exist nor apply in Laterano.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: This is how Laterano treats its guests?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: If you're willing to be a 'guest of Laterano,' Laterano will wholeheartedly treat you in kind.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: —Oren, when did you start standing for Laterano, huh?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: As a Lateran Legatus, do I not have the right?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Not in the Basilica.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Lady Sharon, please quell your anger.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: Hmph. Don't you think it's a little late to be pacifying me, cardinal?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Your Grace, I beg your understanding. The Legatus who contradicted you will be given an appropriate punishment. And rest assured of the Lateran Curia's goodwill during your stay in the guesthouse.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Madame Sciurus, I beg your pardon as well. This fault for this minor misunderstanding lies with our shortcomings. If you would be willing to magnanimously accept my apologies, I hope to invite you in a short while to the side rooms for a talk.
Sciurus looks at Yucatan, and Yucatan gives a subtle nod.

steps.name: Scathing Leithanian
steps.text: Hah, Laterans. My, my.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Alessoe, Mattina, please look after these three most important guests in my stead.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Oren, come with me.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Here comes the punishment. Alright, alright...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yes, the deceased in Pagus Stevonus did not leave behind a will nor any prior registration of one. I'll return to the Notarial Hall in a bit and submit for double-checking.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Currently? I'm at Pagus Stevonus Central Hospital... No, no, I'm alright, I just found a girl injured in a fall, I'm taking her to be examined right now...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: No, I wasn't in a traffic accident...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: No, the parents aren't with her. She's still unconscious, and for the time being we can't confirm her family circumstances. Once she wakes up, I'll bring her back to her guardians.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Right, and if she doesn't wake up soon, I might need to use Notarial Hall privileges to...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: ...Pardon? I can consider this one of my practical assignments...? Alright, I'll fill in all the documents after it's over.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Ah... sorry for that, I'm finished.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: It's alright! The doc's physical checkup is done. No wounds anywhere, nothing on her head, so it probably wasn't a knock on the brain.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: But the girl does have a small fever. Odds are she was ill. She'll still need a few more tests before we're sure what caused her to pass out, but it won't be anything too bad.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Doc's set her up in Ward 2127. You can wait there for the examination results.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Is she your sister? Are you on duty? Why are you bringing your little sister on an executor shift? I barely ever see executors here in Stevonus!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: She's not my sister.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: So why did you bring her here? Is she your target? Oh, Heavens, are executors really that ruthless? You'd execute a little girl like that? What did she do?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I only came across her in the street. She's not my target. She just lives in the vicinity, in all likelihood.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Really? She must be new around here, then.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: This is the only hospital in Stevonus, so all the kids come here for checkups when they're sick... you should see the sight of the consulting room at Pediatrics whenever the seasons change. It's exhausting!

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Lucky I'm on shift at Recovery next week. Have you heard of our Recovery department? It's famous!

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: The wheelchair rapid-fire competition last year there, oh, heavens me, I've never seen guns blaze that fast before, I still suspect that must've been a Gun-Knight... a little bit young for it, though.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: What's that look for? Didn't I tell you Recovery was famous? We have multiple people from the Basilica all recuperating here!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Did you just say... the girl I brought here was newly moved into Stevonus?

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: I've never seen her before, that's why. If she's not your sister, then a kid that small can't have come scampering from another pagus, can she?

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Well, obviously, there's the possibility I've just never seen her by pure chance. But I can tell a girl like her falls ill day in and day out... I've seen too many of them!

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Where was I? Consulting in Pediatrics? Listen, last week...

steps.name: Serious Nurse
steps.text: Here you are gossiping with the family again, Elisa. The doctor wants you at the test center to pick up the results.

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: On it—

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: You're sure you fetched the right report?

steps.name: Blabbermouth Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Yyyes. Is there a problem?

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: I've never seen a blood analysis this strange before.

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: Once it's photocopied, send the original to the head doctor's office, along with this note from me.

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: I need to pay a visit to Recovery.

steps.name: Lateran Citizen?
steps.text: Hmph, that attendant's headed for the head doctor's office. So what now, Patia?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Allocate two to hold the report-deliverer back. Don't go big. Just hold things off, win a little time, and we're fine.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What about that doctor?

steps.name: Lateran Citizen?
steps.text: It looks like he's gone for Recovery. But not the end Cecelia's in.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Hm? That works. This way, the executor'll still be in the dark for now.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Everyone else, with me. We'll draw the executor away, and get Cecelia out before the hospital's people reach her.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Remember, move quick, but don't be rough with Cecelia.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: She's our companion.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Don't make her hate us.

a.text: Mamma, why do we need to go so far every time we meet Daddy? It's really dark now...
Because... Daddy's not able to come to Lateran City. He can't live with us.
Then can't we stay with Daddy?
Daddy wouldn't want you to stay with him, Cecelia. You'll understand when you're older...

Why...? Does Daddy not like me? Is it because I'm not good enough?
If I'm a good girl, can Daddy be with us all the time?
Cecelia... you have to trust Daddy. He loves you, even if he can't be by our side.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Unnh... nnh....

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You're awake!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Who... Where am I...?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You're in the hospital, Miss. You fainted in the street, and I took you here since I couldn't find your parents.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Hospital... is this a hospital?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: No... you—you're wearing a uniform, Mamma said...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Has your mama been telling you things?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (Come to think of it, when I first saw her, wasn't she hiding from me...?)

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: It's alright, Miss, I can take you to find your mama. I'm a good guy.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: You can help me find Mamma? Ma—Mamma got taken away by people in gowns!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (This might just be a kidnapping case! Is that why she was all alone there?)

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Okay, little Miss, stay calm. I'm a Notarial Hall executor. I'll help you find your mama. How did she get taken away?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: You're a Notarial Hall...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: That's right, I'm from the Notarial Hall. My name's Ezell. Look, here's my name tag.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Will you really help me find Mamma?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Of course. What's your name?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: ...I'm Cecelia.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: ...Nngh...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Huh?! What's wrong with... your halo...?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (What is this about...? Even in the most downcast moods, Sankta halos don't dim like this.)

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (Unless...)

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (But a child this small wouldn't even have a patron firearm yet. What could explain this...?)

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: ...Nnnh...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (No. Beyond that...)

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia, how do you feel? Is your halo...?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Sometimes... it goes like this... Mamma says I'm ill... it'll be fine soon...
Ezell has realized something.
Amidst her current pain, Cecelia is anxious about her missing mother too.
But he cannot sense any of her pain, nor anxiety, relayed from her.
Cecelia... is without a doubt a Sankta.
How could this be possible?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia, are you...

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Are you this girl's relative?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Functionally.

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Come with me. She's got somewhat special circumstances, and the doctor said he needs to talk with you in private.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: There was a strong gust of wind just now. I'll close the window, in case she'd catch a cold.

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Hm? Of course.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Alright. Cecelia, just get some rest, I'll be right back.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Don't worry, Cecelia. We'll keep you company.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: The rooftop.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You said Cecelia's circumstances were special. Special how?

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Well... we can't be exactly sure yet. We'll need to wait for the diagnosis. The doctor will be here shortly. Just hold on, and we'll see what he has to say.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I've already reported Cecelia's situation to the Notarial Hall. My colleagues are fast on their way.

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Tell me who you are.

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: I'm an attendant, right? What are you talking about? The doctor will be here momentarily.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Would a normal hospital attendant get nervous hearing the words 'Notarial Hall?'

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: So you suckered me... I only needed to keep you here for a short while anyway. If I were you, I wouldn't be giving myself trouble.

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Patia said to be more gentle with Cecelia... but not with you.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: 'Patia,' was it?

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: You'd do well to forget that one.

steps.name: Reserved Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Come on out. Let's give our Notarial Hall man some break time.
